description: This file contains shell functions for performing a netgear Orbi device upgrade, including flashing kernel and root filesystem partitions via tar archive extraction and loop device management.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade_netgear_orbi_upgrade
methods.description: Main function coordinating the upgrade process for Netgear Orbi devices, verifying necessary tools, locating partitions, and executing the flash routine.

methods.name: netgear_orbi_do_flash
methods.description: Performs the core flashing process: extracting kernel and root filesystem, setting up loop devices, formatting, and copying backup data.
